# Plan: SDK quickstart docs (DX review)

## Context

PLAN.md describes the onboarding flow a developer follows to make their first
SDK call. This file is the /plan-devex-review working plan: it records the
review evidence, the developer perspective, each decision as it is made, and
the final review report. Review mode: DX POLISH (hold the supplied scope,
make every declared touchpoint bulletproof). Product type: SDK + Docs.

Evidence available: PLAN.md (8 declared steps) and CLAUDE.md only. No README,
package.json, docs/, examples/, CHANGELOG, source, or runtime output exists in
this repo. Every friction point below is traced to a declared step; every
consequence is a labeled prediction until measured.

## Step 0 artifacts

TARGET DEVELOPER PERSONA
========================
Who:       A hands-on developer integrating this SDK for the first time.
Context:   Wants to make ONE successful SDK call to decide whether the SDK is
           worth their time. Arrives at the repo, not a hosted docs site.
Tolerance: Unknown (not supplied). Industry benchmark for this persona: >10 min
           to first call is Red Flag territory (50-70% abandon). Predicted.
Expects:   Install command, a key they can get themselves, a copy-paste
           snippet that works. Predicted from persona, not measured.

Source: confirmed in the review request (CLAUDE.md). Not re-asked.

## Onboarding flow (under review, as supplied)

Step 1: clone the repo.
Step 2: install bun manually if not present.
Step 3: copy .env.example to .env and fill in 8 environment variables.
Step 4: run database migrations against your local Postgres.
Step 5: start the dev server.
Step 6: open the docs in a separate tab.
Step 7: register an API key by emailing the team.
Step 8: paste the key into your .env, restart the server, then make
your first SDK call.

No quickstart command, no hosted sandbox, no copy-pasteable curl example.
No measured turnaround, outputs, or runtime behavior were supplied.

## Decision ledger
